steps.en: A daily summary of notices created is produced automatically
steps.id: Ringkasan harian notice yang dibuat dihasilkan otomatis
steps.why_en: Nothing runs daily; the report is only built when someone presses export.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang berjalan harian; report hanya dibuat saat seseorang menekan export.

steps.en: The report lists the details of the notices that were created
steps.id: Report memuat rincian notice yang dibuat
steps.why_en: Notices from some sources are in separate reports and EEPS notices are in none.
steps.why_id: Notice dari beberapa sumber ada di report terpisah dan notice EEPS tidak masuk satu pun.

steps.en: The report appears on the OIC's dashboard
steps.why_en: No dashboard or routing for this report exists; staff must open the Report menu themselves.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada dashboard atau routing untuk report ini; staf harus membuka menu Report sendiri.

steps.en: The officer can download the report to read the details
steps.id: Petugas dapat mengunduh report untuk membaca rinciannya
